pr_title: ddl: fix some unit test funcion that can't run independently
pr_body:
<!--

### What problem does this PR solve?
<!--

Please create an issue first to describe the problem.

There MUST be one line starting with "Issue Number:  " and 
linking the relevant issues via the "close" or "ref".

For more info, check https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/contribute-code.html#referring-to-an-issue.

-->

Issue Number: close #31085

Problem Summary:

Some test cases can't run independently:

```
make ut X='run ddl TestRenameTables'
```

or 

```
make failpoint-enable;
cd ddl;
go test -run TestRenameTables
```

It reports an error "[ddl:-1]failed to notify PD the placement rules: infoSyncer is not initialized"

### What is changed and how it works?



When the test case run with others, the global variable is initialized by other test cases

https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/61d13b561c46839b589858c02399c95c891a08df/domain/infosync/info.go#L168-L170

This is a workaround to make it possible to run the single test case.


Modification on `tools/check/ut.go` is unrelated to this fix, it just make the output easier for debugging.
